answer: Proof-of-network-vantage: each epoch, an agent proves it runs from a distinct corner of the internet's atlas by submitting signed latency measurements to ten landmark servers, a packet voyage only a real location can produce. Three peers verify the signatures and triangulate the position through a prism of vantage points; identities sharing one datacenter ASN and identical fingerprints are flagged one farm, frozen three epochs, rewards void. Renting 1,000 residential links across distinct ASNs costs ~$30,000 a month, while one honest agent proves its vantage free on its home line, in seconds.
